# StockWhisk

> Cloud inventory management and POS software for retail shops in Bangladesh — barcode billing, stock control, warranty tracking, purchase entries, multi-branch reports.

## About
StockWhisk is a multi-tenant SaaS for retail businesses: POS billing with barcode scanning, real-time stock control across branches, warranty & exchange tracking, purchase management, customer/supplier records, and sales analytics dashboards. Built for Bangladeshi retail shops with full Bengali-language UI.
